description: This Java interface defines a handler for downloadable custom data types within the OpenMRS framework, specifying methods for obtaining MIME types, filenames, and streaming data output.

classes.name: DownloadableDatatypeHandler
classes.description: A Java interface for handling downloadable custom data types, enabling retrieval of MIME types, filenames, and stream writing capabilities.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the given custom datatype and value reference to inform clients how to handle the download.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename suggested for the downloaded content, or null if the framework should assign a default filename.

methods.name: writeToStream
methods.description: Streams the custom datatype's data to the provided output stream, handling IO errors as needed.
